거친 표면은 초음파 시험 시 바람직하지 않은 영향을 주는데, 여기에 해당하는 것은?
options: an increase in the width of front face echo and consequent loss or resolving power

question:
Rough surfaces cause the echo amplitude from discontinuities within the part to:
거친 표면은 시험체 내부 불연속에서 오는 에코 진폭을 어떻게 만드는가?

To eliminate the decrease of sensitivity close to a wall which is parallel to the beam direction, the probe used should be:
빔 진행 방향과 나란한 벽면 근처에서 감도가 떨어지는 것을 없애려면 어떤 탐촉자를 써야 하는가?
options: of as low frequency as possible
large and with a frequency as high as possible

question:
Some information on the shape of a flaw may be given by:
결함의 형상에 대한 정보를 얻을 수 있는 것은?

Of the transducer materials listed below, the most efficient receiver is:
다음 탐촉자 재료 중 수신 효율이 가장 좋은 것은?

The concentration of energy in the far field of a transducer beam:
탐촉자 빔의 원거리음장에서 에너지 집중은?
options: is greatest at the outer edges of the beam
is greatest at the center of the beam
is the same at the outer edges as in the center of the beam
is directly proportional to beam width

question:
In angle beam shear wave testing, skip distance will _______ as the thickness of the test specimen is increased.
사각 횡파 탐상에서 시험체의 두께가 증가하면 스킵거리는 어떻게 되는가?
options: decrease by half with double thickness

question:
The ability of transducers to detect echoes from small defects is a definition for:
작은 결함에서 오는 에코를 검출하는 탐촉자의 능력을 무엇이라 하는가?

In a water (VL= 1.5x105cm/sec) immersion test, ultrasonic energy is transmitted into steel(VT= 3.2x105cm/sec) at an incident angle of 14°. What is the refracted shear wave within the material?
물(VL = 1.5×10⁵ cm/sec) 수침 시험에서 입사각 14°로 강(VT = 3.2×10⁵ cm/sec)에 초음파 에너지가 입사될 때, 재료 내 굴절 횡파의 각도는?

The principal attributes, that determine the differences in ultrasonic velocities among materials, are:
재료마다 초음파 속도가 다른 것을 결정짓는 주된 성질은?

The term that is used to determine the relative transmittance and reflectance of ultrasonic energy at an interface is called:
계면에서 초음파 에너지의 상대적 투과율과 반사율을 결정하는 데 쓰이는 용어는?

In general, when a discontinuity is thin, it is a poor reflector. The maximum reflection is obtained when the thickness of the discontinuity is equal to at least:
일반적으로 불연속이 얇으면 반사가 나쁘다. 최대 반사를 얻으려면 불연속의 두께가 최소 얼마여야 하는가?

When angle beam contact testing a test piece, increasing the incident angle until the second critical angle is reached, results in:
시험체를 사각 직접접촉법으로 탐상할 때, 제2 임계각에 이를 때까지 입사각을 키우면 어떻게 되는가?
options: total reflection of a surface wave

question:
It is possible for a discontinuity, smaller than the transducer, to produce indications of fluctuating amplitude as the search unit is moved laterally if testing is being performed in the:
탐촉자보다 작은 불연속이 탐촉자를 옆으로 움직일 때 진폭이 변동하는 지시를 나타낼 수 있는 경우는?

In an immersion test of a piece of steel or aluminum, the water distance appears on the display as a fairly wide space between the initial pulse and the front surface reflection because of:
강이나 알루미늄 시험편의 수침 탐상에서, 초기 펄스와 표면 반사 사이에 수거리가 상당히 넓게 나타나는 이유는?
options: reduced velocity of sound in water as compared to test specimen
increased velocity of sound in water as compared to test specimen

question:
In the immersion technique, the distance between the face of the transducer and the test surface(water path) is usually adjusted so that the time required to send the sound beam through the water:
수침법에서 탐촉자 면과 시험 표면 사이의 거리(수거리)는 보통 어떻게 조정하는가?
options: is equal to the time required for the sound to travel through the test piece
is greater than the time required for the sound to travel through the test piece
is less than the time required for the sound to travel through the test piece

question:
In immersion testing in a small tank, a manually operated manipulator is used to:
작은 수조에서 수침 탐상할 때 수동 조작기는 어떤 용도로 쓰이는가?

A primary purpose of a reference standard is:
대비시험편의 주된 목적은?
options: to provide a guide for adjusting instrument controls to reveal discontinuities that are considered harmful to the end use of the product
to give the technician a tool for determining exact discontinuity size
to provide assurance that all discontinuities, smaller than a certain specified reference reflector, are capable of being detected by the test
to provide a standard reflector which exactly simulates natural discontinuities of a critical size

question:
A smooth, flat discontinuity, whose major plane is not perpendicular to the direction of sound propagation, may be indicated by:
주된 평면이 음파 진행 방향과 수직이 아닌 매끄럽고 평평한 불연속은 무엇으로 나타날 수 있는가?
options: an echo amplitude comparable in magnitude to the back surface reflection
a complete loss of back surface reflection
an echo amplitude larger in magnitude than the back surface reflection

question:
Attenuation is a difficult quantity to measure accurately, particularly in solid materials at the test frequencies normally used. The overall result usually observed includes other loss mechanisms which can include:
감쇠는 정확히 측정하기 어려운 양이며, 특히 통상 사용하는 시험 주파수에서 고체 재료의 경우 그렇다. 관측되는 전체 결과에 함께 포함되는 손실 기구는?

The attenuation of energy within a material in the far field of the ultrasonic beam may be expressed as the:
초음파 빔의 원거리음장에서 재료 내 에너지 감쇠는 무엇으로 나타낼 수 있는가?

In an immersion inspection of raw material, the water travel distance should be:
원자재를 수침 탐상할 때 수거리는 어떠해야 하는가?
options: equal to the water travel distance used in setting up on the reference standards
equal to the thickness of the material

question:
The angle of reflection is:
반사각은?
options: equal to the angle of incidence
equal to the angle of refraction

question:
The coated, inside surface of the large and of a cathode-ray tube, which becomes luminous when struck by an electron beam, is called:
음극선관 큰 쪽 안쪽 면에 발라져 전자빔이 부딪히면 빛을 내는 물질을 무엇이라 하는가?

The speed with which ultrasonic waves travel through a material is known as its:
초음파가 재료를 통과하는 속도를 무엇이라 하는가?
options: pulse repetition rate of sound energy
pulse recovery rate of sound energy

question:
The amount of energy reflected from a discontinuity will be dependent on:
불연속에서 반사되는 에너지의 양은 무엇에 좌우되는가?

The angle of reflection of an ultrasonic beam at an aluminum-water interface is:
알루미늄-물 계면에서 초음파 빔의 반사각은?
options: approximately ½ the angle of incidence
approximately 4 time the angle of incidence
equal to the angle of incidence

question:
Significant errors in ultrasonic thickness measurement can occur if:
초음파 두께 측정에서 큰 오차가 생길 수 있는 경우는?
options: the test frequency is varying at a constant rate
the velocity of propagation deviates substantially from an assumed constant value for a given material
water is employed as a couplant between the transducer and the part being measured
None of the above should cause errors

question:
In a basic plus-echo ultrasonic instrument, the component that coordinates the action and timing of other components is called a:
기본 펄스-에코 초음파 장비에서 다른 구성품의 동작과 시간을 조율하는 부품을 무엇이라 하는가?
options: marker circuit or range marker circuit

question:
The incident angles, at which 90°refraction of longitudinal and shear waves occurs, are called:
종파와 횡파가 90°로 굴절되는 입사각을 무엇이라 하는가?

In contact testing, shear waves can be induced in the test material by:
직접접촉법에서 시험 재료에 횡파를 발생시키는 방법은?
options: placing a X-cut crystal directly on the surface of the materials and coupling through a film of oil
using two transducers on opposite sides of the test specimen
placing a spherical, acoustic lens on the face of the transducer
using a transducer mounted on a plastic wedge so that sound enters the part at an angle

question:
In ASME Section Ⅲ, Subsection NF, examination of Class-a bolts over 4 inches shall be performed at a nominal frequency of:
ASME Section Ⅲ, Subsection NF에서 4인치를 넘는 Class-a 볼트의 검사는 어떤 공칭 주파수로 수행해야 하는가?

ASME Section Ⅲ, Subsection NB, states that when examining plate, the minimum scanning overlap shall be:
ASME Section Ⅲ, Subsection NB에 따르면 판재를 검사할 때 최소 주사 중첩량은?

In ASME Section Ⅲ, Subsection NB, all forgings in the rough forged or finished condition shall be examined in accordance with:
ASME Section Ⅲ, Subsection NB에서 황단조 또는 완성 상태의 모든 단조품은 무엇에 따라 검사해야 하는가?

For ultrasonic examination of forgings in accordance with SA-388, the straight beam transducer shall be:
SA-388에 따라 단조품을 초음파 검사할 때 수직 탐촉자는 어떠해야 하는가?

ASME Section Ⅷ, Division I, requires that discontinuity indications in welds that exceed __________ be recorded.
ASME Section Ⅷ, Division I에서는 용접부의 불연속 지시가 무엇을 초과하면 기록하도록 요구하는가?
options:
75 percent of the reference level
 b. 80 percent of the reference level

question:
Ultrasonic examination of welds per ASME B31.3 shall be in accordance with ______ .
ASME B31.3에 따른 용접부 초음파 검사는 무엇에 따라야 하는가?

In AWS D1.1, the horizontal linearity of the ultrasonic test instrument shall be within ± ________ percent over 90 percent of the linear range.
AWS D1.1에서 초음파 장비의 수평 직선성은 직선 범위의 90% 구간에서 ±몇 % 이내여야 하는가?

AWS D1.1 requires that the dynamic range of the instrument's CRT display shall be such that a difference of ________ dB of amplitude can be easily detected on the CRT.
AWS D1.1은 장비 CRT 화면의 동적범위가 몇 dB의 진폭 차이를 쉽게 식별할 수 있어야 한다고 요구하는가?

Angle beam search units, used in accordance with AWS D1.1, shall be marked to indicate :
AWS D1.1에 따라 사용하는 사각 탐촉자에는 무엇을 표시해야 하는가?

An indication, whose response is 20 percent of the reference level, with a length of 1/2 inch was found in a one inch butt weld . In accordance with ASME SectionⅢ, Div. 1 Subsection NE, this indication is unacceptable. True : ___________________ False : ___________________
1인치 맞대기 용접부에서 기준레벨의 20% 응답에 길이 1/2인치인 지시가 발견되었다. ASME Section Ⅲ, Div.1 Subsection NE에 따르면 이 지시는 불합격이다.

In AWS D1.1, the search unit shall produce a sound beam in the material being tested within ± ________ degree(s) of the following proper angles.
AWS D1.1에서 탐촉자는 시험 재료 안에서 규정 각도의 ±몇 도 이내로 음빔을 발생시켜야 하는가?

In accordance with AWS D1.1, each angle beam search unit shall be checked after each _________ of use to determine that the beam angle is within the permitted tolerance.
AWS D1.1에 따라 각 사각 탐촉자는 빔 각도가 허용 공차 안에 있는지 확인하기 위해 얼마마다 점검해야 하는가?

In accordance with ASME Section Ⅲ, Division 1 Subsection NG, plates used for core structures with thicknesses greater than 3/4 inch, shall use the acceptance standards of SA-578. True : ___________________ False : ___________________
ASME Section Ⅲ, Division 1 Subsection NG에 따르면 두께 3/4인치를 넘는 노심 구조용 판재는 SA-578의 합격기준을 적용해야 한다.

In accordance with ASME SectionⅠ, Ultrasonic examination is not required for electroslag welds in ferritic materials. True : ___________________ False : ___________________
ASME Section Ⅰ에 따르면 페라이트계 재료의 일렉트로슬래그 용접부에는 초음파 검사가 요구되지 않는다.
In accordance with ASME B31.1, Ultrasonic examination is not required for welds. True : ___________________ False : ___________________

Reference standards (calibration blocks) are to be constructed from materials that .
대비시험편(교정 블록)은 어떤 재료로 제작해야 하는가?
options: came from the same heat as the test parts
have a similar metallurgical structures as the test parts
are the same material specification, grade, and heat treatment as parts
are of the same thickness as the test parts

question:
Personnel conducting UT shall be certified in accordance with .
초음파 검사를 수행하는 요원은 무엇에 따라 자격을 인증받아야 하는가?
options: the Code of Ethics for ASME

The calibration blocks for L-wave testing of castings shall use SDHs as shown in .
주조품의 종파 탐상용 교정 블록은 어디에 제시된 대로 측면 구멍(SDH)을 사용해야 하는가?

question:
Scanning practices call for transducer positions to .
주사 방법에서 탐촉자 위치는 어떻게 하도록 규정하는가?
options: never scan at rates in excess of 6 in./sec

question:
Several screen height linearity checks yielded the half amplitude results listed below for initial setting of 100,80,60,40, and 20 percent FSH. which set of readings (%FSH) is considered out of calibration?
화면 높이 직선성 점검에서 초기 설정 100, 80, 60, 40, 20 %FSH에 대해 아래와 같은 절반 진폭 결과를 얻었다. 교정을 벗어난 것으로 보는 측정값(%FSH)은?

question:
(ASME Section Ⅷ-Div.1) - What are the three indications that are unacceptable regardless of length?
(ASME Section Ⅷ-Div.1) 길이와 관계없이 불합격인 세 가지 지시는?
options: Cracks, lack of fusion, and incomplete penetration

question:
(ASME Section Ⅷ-Div.1) - What may be used to fulfill the examination and demonstration requirements of SNT-TC-1A and the employer's written practice?
(ASME Section Ⅷ-Div.1) SNT-TC-1A와 사업주 절차서의 시험 및 실기 요구사항을 충족하는 데 사용할 수 있는 것은?

(ASME Section Ⅷ-Div.1) - For 30 mm thickness of weld metal, the indication has 25% amplitude and has 12 mm length. The weld is : Accpetable________Unacceptable________
(ASME Section Ⅷ-Div.1) 두께 30mm 용접금속에서 지시의 진폭이 25%이고 길이가 12mm이다. 이 용접부는?

(ASME Section Ⅷ-Div.2) - The manufacturer shall maintain a record from uncorrected areas having responses that exceed ________.
(ASME Section Ⅷ-Div.2) 제조자는 무엇을 초과하는 응답을 보이는 미보수 부위의 기록을 유지해야 하는가?

(ASME Section Ⅷ-Div.2) - For UT in lieu of RT, the subsurface flaw length shall not exceed ________.
(ASME Section Ⅷ-Div.2) RT 대신 UT를 적용할 때 표면하 결함의 길이는 무엇을 초과해서는 안 되는가?
